listing.name: Call of Duty 3 (CoD3Recomp)
listing.summary: An in-development Call of Duty 3 port with project-reported level loading and early play. The Windows setup/player extracts your own Xbox 360 full XGD1/XGD2/XGD3 or stripped ISO, or uses an installed folder containing default.xex. Its check compares executable size with the compiled target; exact accepted region, revision and cryptographic hashes are unconfirmed. A native source build is separate. This guide has not confirmed the Windows package’s host CPU architecture; the Xbox 360 CPU does not establish it. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
